findings.label: Remote-URL images unbounded
findings.detail: A pasted http(s) image URL is neither client-compressed nor size-checked by the server guard (guard only inspects data: URIs). By design; flag only if remote hotlinks should also be constrained.

findings.label: Server headroom is a fixed constant
findings.detail: The 61440-byte guard assumes the client always targets 51200; if the client ceiling is raised the server constant must move with it. Documented inline as 'small headroom'.
